meta.name: Inch
meta.idea: An inchworm mid-inch, every segment a film frame showing the worm a little further along its own arch.

meta.name: Onion
meta.idea: The caterpillar is its own onion skin: one solid head, and a body made of its fainter earlier frames on a timeline.

meta.name: Stub
meta.idea: Chunky, scruffy and smudged, with a worn-down coloured pencil for a tail that is still drawing its own trail.

meta.name: Rez
meta.idea: Born as big pixels and finer with every segment until the head is clean vector: sketch to finished art in one creature.

meta.name: Hold
meta.idea: A timeline that crawls: segments held for 1, 2, 1, 3 frames, keyframe diamonds on the joints, ruler ticks for legs, a playhead for a head.
